name: Hadas Bashlikov

headline.en: Product Designer with 4 years combining UX/UI design, user research, and development across startups, SaaS, and defense environments.

experience.title: Front End Developer

Collaborated with product managers and designers to translate business requirements into scalable user-facing solutions.

experience.title: UX/UI Designer & Developer

transferable_experience_notes: Front-end development experience (Tabit, WebC) counts toward 'works closely with engineers', 'design systems', and 'technical understanding of implementation constraints' — but NOT toward years as a pure 'Designer' or 'UX Researcher' title.
B.Sc. Computer Science gives strong technical fluency for Design-Engineer / Design Systems roles that explicitly value a technical background.

Defense-sector experience (CRG/Israeli Air Force) is relevant evidence for 'works under pressure', 'mission-critical systems', and 'operational/enterprise UX' — flag as a possible sensitivity for some companies, not a gap.
